Abhishek Sharma Breaks Rohit Sharma's Record in T20Is

Abhishek Sharma has set a new record for the most sixes by an Indian in the first over of a T20 International match, surpassing Rohit Sharma's previous record. Ishan Kishan is ranked third in this category.
